verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 6ae950600949ec5c868b86cd0db140c9a9bb5780 implements the bounded Inspector Details layer for the Editor Inspector panel. InspectorPanel keeps the selected-block summary and node actions visible, moves raw Inspector facts behind a Details disclosure, starts that facts list collapsed with hidden state and display: none, expands it to the existing facts-list grid when Details is clicked, and resets Details closed when the selected Outline item changes. Focused RED first failed in src/tests/selectionContextSummary.test.ts because the Inspector did not render an inspector-details-layer after node actions. Focused RED after the first implementation failed because the facts list lacked hidden state. Focused RED after browser review failed because the CSS did not include .inspector-details-layer .facts-list[hidden], allowing the existing .facts-list display grid rule to override the hidden attribute. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/selectionContextSummary.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 3 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 89 passed test files, 308 passed tests, and build. Worktree browser evidence in live Backend mode opened http://127.0.0.1:54551/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend at http://127.0.0.1:54550, confirmed Source: Backend read, Authoring: limited, Details collapsed with factsHidden true, factsDisplay none, and factsRects 0, then clicked Details and confirmed factsHidden false, factsDisplay grid, Node title, and 14 raw fact rows, then selected Columns and confirmed Details reset closed. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 89 passed test files, 308 passed tests, and build. Main browser evidence at http://127.0.0.1:60029/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend at http://127.0.0.1:60028 confirmed Source: Backend read, Authoring: limited, Details collapsed with display none, Details expanded with Node title and 14 fact rows, Columns selection reset Details closed, and 0 browser error logs. Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. Editor npm install in the lane still reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities. Project Control baseline npm run check first failed with a transient Vitest worker startup timeout, and the immediate rerun passed before any Project Control record edits. git deregistered the Editor worktree and branch deletion succeeded, but the residual .worktrees/editor-inspector-detail-navigation-foundation folder could not be removed because local command policy blocked recursive Remove-Item -Recurse. The previous residual Editor worktree folder for editor-selection-context-summary-foundation remains a local cleanup risk. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor Inspector Details layer and does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
